# Vendored Maia 3 material

This directory preserves the preferred source needed to modify and rebuild the
Core ML model distributed with Chessnut Coach.

- upstream: <https://github.com/CSSLab/maia3>
- source revision: `1e13597c42d4858b7cfd7cfdae01e297263364b2`
- model: <https://huggingface.co/UofTCSSLab/Maia3-5M>
- model revision: `b6559de2398d7140b985f28fd2c19fb5e47ddabe`
- checkpoint SHA-256: `ba14208b2992d85502f5fb501934abf6aaaeb355e9f3fdf90e326911f562524f`
- license: GNU AGPL-3.0-only; see `source/LICENSE`

Files were vendored without altering the upstream Python source. The separate
Core ML conversion and iOS adapter are documented in `MAIA3_INTEGRATION.md`.
